nieuw.titel: Choose Warriors of Chaos for straightforward combat as a beginner
nieuw.tekst: For a beginner who wants to send combat troops straight in and have them stay in the fight, he recommends Warriors of Chaos. He considers them the most beginner-friendly army.

bronnen.citaat: I think warriors are actually the army that best suits that.

extraCitaten.citaat: have them stick around in combat

nieuw.titel: Keep Ghorros Warhoof near Centigor to avoid drunkenness
nieuw.tekst: If using Ghorros Warhoof to avoid Centigor drunkenness, keep him nearby. The speaker thinks this may be workable even though he cannot join their unit.
nieuw.waarom: He considers drunkenness nearly as punishing as failing Stupidity and says there is little else to mitigate it.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says Ghorros Warhoof is heavy cavalry and Centigor are light cavalry, so Ghorros cannot join their unit.

bronnen.citaat: As long as he's nearby to avoid the drunkenness, it might be okay.

extraCitaten.citaat: you can't put him in the unit with the centigor.
